slices.title: Data model, scoped revisions, Domain rules and JS mirror, i18n scaffolding
acceptance: All existing tests are green without assertion changes (php.test exact-key and stale-write cases, workspace.test, http.test concurrency [200,409]).

roles-parity: same statuses and normalised state in PHP and JS for every command and actor; messages are equal for new paths; known old differences are listed; publicData equals publicWorkspace for each actor on a rich data set; Domain::stale agrees with JS.

roles.test covers the §5.2 matrix, the outsideEntry truth table, limit semantics (drafts and hidden excluded, finished before the date refused, paused publishing), CONTACT cases, entry.self gates (saved draw, minor in an untrusted tournament), the owner withdraw branch (open 200, closed 403), athlete.save (age 16 rule, 5 profiles, single self, identity lock), Clubs::pick (Cyrillic, Kraków/Krakow, merged, unaffiliated, pending name), the self-entry club override and identity keep, tournament.hide with hiddenFrom restore and tombstones, and forgetProfile/detach finishing when a bracket has results.

domain.http on MariaDB and MySQL: club name collisions (Straße/Strasse, Kraków/Krakow) through account.save and profile.save give 409 and leave the original row unchanged; persist deletes a profile row, or the transaction rolls back; stamps are stored; migrate twice gives exit 0; rollback-floor gives 7 with community data and lower without.
engine.test: unaffiliated pairs have cost 0; community.test: Clubs::key equals clubKey; i18n.test lists the new dictionaries, has no collisions, and every new server message has an EN entry.
php -l and node --check pass on every new file.

slices.title: app_settings, central effective config, paid switch decision, Admin settings API
slices.description:
- Migration 0008 (app_settings, no starting row, no floor).
- Settings.php, real implementation: get, normalize, save with a version check, idempotent effective() with signup, payments, organizers, supportEmail and stripeCheck, the derived keys, degraded states and fallback when the table is missing.
- Central overlay: Routes::dispatch computes effective for session, upload and peek-with-cookie routes and for routes flagged 'settings'=>true, passes the PDO into RouteContext, RouteContext::$config is the effective config and RouteContext::$file the raw one; public-config gets 'settings'=>true. Config: signup_force_off default.
- Billing: freePeriodSet with groups A (free-signup exempt) and B (Access::compute with enforce=true gives no full access); requireFrom with scope free-signup extended to group B; keep sets group B exempt as free-signup; checkout refuses 409 while enforce is false; summary and state get the effective config through the context.
- routes/settings.php: admin-settings (view §8.2 with groups, organizersPending, limits, the last 50 account_audit rows), admin-settings-save (version, Stripe check outside the transaction, test-mode confirmation, free_period_decision with counts, support e-mail with old to new value in the audit note, organizers on/paused), admin-stripe-check (6/h).
- Guard test for raw switch reads.
acceptance: settings.test: full §3.3 matrix through the bridge, idempotence of effective(), normalize, save validation; the guard test finds no raw reads of billing_enforce, signup_enabled, support_email or organizers outside the allowed files.

settings.http: no row means config behaviour; off→free gives new accounts free-signup; free→paid with the Stripe stub covers prices ok, stripe_not_ready, test_mode, free_period_decision with group A and group B counts (an Admin-created member in free mode is in group B), keep and requireFrom (<14 days gives 422), and a paid→free→paid cycle; degraded when billing_enabled is false; missing table gives no 500; stale version gives 409; non-admin gives 403; history is listed.
With payments=paid stored in the database and billing_enforce=false in the file, billing-sync, me and command agree on access.
Guest chat and public routes without a cookie open no extra database connection (asserted with a connection counter or timing fixture).

slices.title: Member bootstrap/command for organizers, signup with roles without lock, step-up, Admin member actions, cleanup and retention jobs, chat lobby
acceptance: roles.http: signup is atomic with roles (a bad athlete creates no account); mass-assignment fields are ignored; signup with an athlete finishes while another connection holds app_meta FOR UPDATE; the club quota fallback gives an unaffiliated athlete with a pending name; the duplicate-e-mail limit returns 429 for every outcome.

Organizer flow over HTTP: tournament, limits, finished before the date refused, paused publishing, profile with a new club and guardian consent, entry, check-in with a club override, draw, result, #screen poll with unchanged.

Revision isolation: an organizer looping at the rate limit plus athlete entries in tournament A never cause 409 on an editor's checkin.save in tournament B; the global member bucket returns 429 with Retry-After and staff are unaffected.
Step-up: reauth after a simulated idle period, organizer-unlock restores access, chat and athlete routes are unaffected.
JSON leak scan for organizer, editor and club finds 0 hits of foreign names, birth dates and ids; organizerSnapshot publicData equals the full-load publicData.
Admin over HTTP: trust/untrust, block with hide, bulk action, ownerOf, filters, pendingOrganizers count; account_audit rows are written.

Account deletion of an athlete and of an organizer: the profiles rows are gone or anonymised with owner_user_id NULL; deletion succeeds when the bracket has other results; accounts-cleanup skips accounts with community data; community-retention anonymises past the cutoff.
The chat lobby has no untrusted community tournaments and o is 2 for an untrusted organizer.

athletes.http: age rule for under-16 self, 5-profile cap, single self, identity lock (409); athlete-entry returns open 200; closed/no selfEntry/past date 403; hidden, draft and missing give byte-identical 404; repeat 409; saved draw in the category 409; minor in an untrusted tournament 409; disallowed event 422; withdraw open 200 and closed 403; tombstone after an organizer withdrawal; athlete-forget removes or anonymises the profile; paid mode gives entry 402 while withdraw, save, forget and athlete return 200; public-clubs lists only verified clubs.

openQuestions.question: O17: Can one parent account hold several athlete profiles (siblings), or strictly one profile per account?
openQuestions.recommendedDefault: Yes, up to 5 profiles per account (at most one 'self', the rest 'guardian'). Setting the ATHLETES_PER_ACCOUNT constant to 1 restores one profile per account without a model change.

openQuestions.question: O19: May a self-registered organizer (e.g. a coach) enter their own athletes into other people's open tournaments?
openQuestions.recommendedDefault: Yes, but only into tournaments that accept self-entries and belong to staff or a confirmed organizer. The organizer sees only their own entries there.

openQuestions.question: O18/R16: Should minors (under 18) be blocked from self-entering tournaments of organizers the Admin has not yet confirmed, and should such tournaments stay off the homepage and the chat lobby?
openQuestions.recommendedDefault: Yes. The tournaments still publish immediately at their own URL and in the athletes' list, with a 'community, unconfirmed organizer' badge. The Admin confirms organizers with one button from a counted queue.

openQuestions.question: O1: Can club representatives and editors enter staff athletes (mostly children) into community tournaments?
openQuestions.recommendedDefault: Only into tournaments of confirmed organizers, with editors limited to profiles they created and a privacy notice shown.

openQuestions.question: O20: How long are community athlete data (profiles added by organizers, community entries) kept after the athlete's last tournament?
openQuestions.recommendedDefault: 24 months (RETENTION_MONTHS), then anonymised. To be confirmed in the legal session.

openQuestions.question: O14: Will the owner wait for legal texts (privacy policy, terms, guardian consent) before switching signup to 'Otwarta, bezpłatna'?
openQuestions.recommendedDefault: Strongly recommended: deploy now with signup off, run the legal session, then open signup in the panel.

openQuestions.question: O21: Is it acceptable that organizers must re-enter their password for organizer tools after 30 minutes idle and at least every 12 hours, while chat stays signed in?
openQuestions.recommendedDefault: Yes, the same limits as staff sessions.
